standard.note: Yucatán's 2025 plate is a simple, clean white design with a maroon (guinda) stripe and the state name at the top, with the national and state seals at the bottom.

plates.title: Current design (2025)
plates.fact: Yucatán's 2025 plate is a simple, clean white design with a maroon (guinda) stripe and the state name at the top, with the national and state seals at the bottom.

notes: The re-plating started June 2, 2025 (yucatan.gob.mx comunicado 25-032 and note 9038). It was extended six months (note 10274, Dec 31, 2025), and the final deadline was June 30, 2026, with fines afterward, so the earlier green-lettered design should be gone. yucatan.gob.mx press photos (e.g. docs/saladeprensa/9038_1_179.jpg, 800x450) show the plate being handed over a counter, not clean artwork, so they are not used. Yucatán handles disability parking with a tarjeton (placard), and I found no separate disability plate design. No specialty plates found.
